description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline callback functionality in the Rialto client media pipeline, including tests for notification forwarding of playback state, network state, and QoS information.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the media pipeline callback notifications in the Rialto client.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment and destroys the media pipeline.

methods.name: NotifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Test that playback state notifications are forwarded correctly to the client.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkState
methods.description: Test that network state notifications are forwarded correctly to the client.

methods.name: NotifyQos
methods.description: Test that QoS information is forwarded correctly to the client.
